risk_summary: The disclosure provides useful quantitative operating data, including occupancy, rent collections, portfolio size, and acquisition spending, but relies substantially on standard forward-looking disclaimers and management beliefs. COVID-19, tenant rent relief, receivables, and uncollected rent remain material risks, partially mitigated by grocery-anchored properties and improving occupancy. Extensive REIT terminology and non-GAAP measures may complicate comparability and risk interpretation.
